methodAndLimits.actualRuntime: Actual current Reader and every visual provider, including all source/inline/supplemental components and actual translation guard/locale packs. Test-only export exposes original source figure registry for omission checks.
methodAndLimits.adapters: RN structural elements, ruby text adapters for ordinary source prose, appearance/layout/app services isolated. Native technical/context label renderers and source-bound guards remain actual production code. No assessment/visual provider masked.
methodAndLimits.covered: 96 lessons including18 runtime supplemental,8existingweeks,13locales; primary sourceHash/caption/Royal alt alignment; all42 retained figures and legacy illustration/management/concept IDs; all317 current scoped reading contexts; all106 active asset identity/format/dimensions.
methodAndLimits.notClaimed: Independent pixel rerereview of previously accepted artwork, physical/browser/device interaction, native linguistic/domain/full-source acceptance, measured learner duration or release approval.

historicalDebtDisposition: Old global-axis debt/conflict fields are preserved as history. Current exact lesson/revision/label-scoped overrides cover every listed old debt label and are actually rendered; ambiguous global single-character/word overrides were not introduced.
